csv_agency: St of AK DOT & Pub Facilities - Southcoast Region
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Alaska, Department of Transportation and Public Facilities, may be seeking a consultant to provide design and construct permanent repairs (PR) to assets damaged by the December 2020 Storm in the Southcoast Region of Alaska for DDIRs AK 2020 01 HNH001, AK 2020 01 HNH002, AK 2021 01 PTG002, AK 2021 01 PTG003, and AK 2021 01 SGY001. Repairs may include, but are not limited to, asphalt, embankment, geotextile, riprap, drainage, roadside hardware, retaining walls, and utilities. This project will repair sites in Hoonah, Petersburg & Skagway.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Sanitation Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering

services: Design-build services for permanent repair works; requested disciplines include design-build/developer, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, sanitation engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering.

- Primarily roadway and culvert repair after storm damage, not a new bridge or special structure.
- Scope focuses on rehabilitation/permanent repairs, which are generally less relevant to sbp.
- Includes retaining walls and civil engineering, but no indication of complex spans or architecturally demanding structures.
- Design-build format offers some planning component, yet the structural ambition appears low.
